articles.summary: The Restructuring Program focuses Clinical Genomics on profitability and adds resources in Sterilization and Disinfection Control, Calibration Solutions and Asia LAKEWOOD, Colo., Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mesa Laboratories, Inc. (NASDAQ: MLAB) (“Mesa,” “we,” “us” or “our”), a global leader in the design and manufacture of critical quality control solutions and life sciences tools, today announced a savings plan (the “Savings Plan”) expected to reduce annualized operating costs by approximately $9.3 million. The Savings Plan consists of a global restructuring program (the "Restructuring Program"), a reduction in our San Diego, California facility footprint and reduced third-party spending. We plan to reinvest approximately $4.3 million of the savings into the business to drive profitable growth, for a net annualized cost reduction of approximately $5.0 million. articles.summary: Lakewood, Colo., Oct. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Mesa Laboratories, Inc. (NASDAQ:MLAB) (we, us, our, “Mesa” or the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.16 per share of common stock. The dividend will be payable on December 15, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 30, 2026. About Mesa Laboratories, Inc. Mesa is a global leader in the design and manufacture of critical quality control solutions and life science tools for regulated applications in the pharmaceutical, healthcare and medical device industries. With manufacturing operations in the United States and Europe, and commercial reach across North America, Europe, the Asia Pacific Region, and throughout the world, we serve customers whose applications demand accuracy, reliability and regulatory compliance.
